title: Source Ingest Provenance
text:
Source ingest records SHA256 identifiers and source references for documents
placed inside the memory root `sources/` sandbox. The reference trail is
tamper-evident: if a source changes later, the stored digest no longer matches
the original evidence.

title: Privacy Public Clean
text:
Public release cleanup removes private paths, local usernames, old internal
project names, archives, and secret-like material from the distributable tree.
The public-clean test is intentionally strict so regressions are visible.

title: MemoryWiki PKM Positioning
text:
MemoryWiki combines chat memory with personal knowledge management. It keeps
session summaries, semantic notes, procedures, and source references in a
local-first Markdown tree so agents can recall durable context without treating
memory as higher-priority instruction.

title: MemoryWiki Overview
text:
MemoryWiki is a local-first memory wiki for AI agents. It stores durable project
context in Markdown, keeps source provenance, supports explicit session saves,
and exposes read-first recall through CLI and MCP.

title: Lifecycle Governance
text:
MemoryWiki lifecycle checks review stale, weak, duplicate, or oversized memory
ledgers before release or maintenance work. The default posture is dry-run
first: propose archive and repair actions, then require explicit write approval.

title: Cross Project Recall
text:
Cross-project recall works by installing a lightweight startup guide and an MCP
client config into each project. Agents start read-only, run index maintenance
dry-runs, and recall project plus global memory before substantial work.
